modifications: Kernels are rewritten onto mlx2's existing #3912 QMV_HEADER (float input sums as the lab MLX fork does since 2d6705923), not omlx's header.

Gate+up reads gate and up rows from two separate expert tables (Qwen3.6 keeps fused gate/up pinned off); the slot is grid z as in mlx2's #3912 port instead of omlx's flattened block index. Arithmetic per row is unchanged.
Down/combine keeps mlx2's #3912 product form (T(result) * score in T) and generalises the fold to TOPK; for TOPK 10 and FAST 0 it is the GPU-qualified top-10 kernel's order.

Admission is stricter than omlx: bf16 only (no served-SiLU probe exists for fp16), q4/g64 only, exact QuantizedSwitchLinear class, matching gate/up/down tables, scores required. Runtime also requires the served SiLU probe to match the kernels' metal::exp sigmoid.
No self-disable: a decline is counted by reason (bounded to 16 reasons plus 'other') and runs the composed reference body; a kernel error propagates.
Default off; a selected fused expert kernel (scalar/tile4) and the candidate are mutually exclusive.
